page.layout: One page of text, single column, dedication lines set in mixed roman, italic and capitals; no margin notes; no running head or page number visible.

main_text.head: Illustrissimis, Clarissimis, Generis Splendore, Virtutis Encomiô, Pietatis ac Eruditionis Celebritate Famigeratissimis Viris.
main_text.p: Dn. ABRAHAMO LIENHART, Præfectura olim in Laupen/ summa cum laude defuncto, suo è Sacris Baptismi undis Suscep-tori omni observantia in æternum prosequendo
Dn. ABRAHAMO JENNERO, Olim Redituûm Ecclesiasticorum Oeconomo, nunc Scholarchæ & Quæstori ærarij Academici, nullo amoris & honoris cultu satis demerendo colendo.
Dn. NICOLAO HIERONIMO MANNUEL, Ducentûm Viro Dignissimo, Meritissimo, Fautori ac Patrono suo omni honoris genere perpetim Venerando, Peramando.
Dn. DANIELI ERNESTO, Agnato suo, omnigena amoris ac honoris reverentiâ afficiundo, prosequendo.
Dn. JACOBO SPENGLERO, Notario Peritissimo, Patruo suo omni obedientia ac honore in ævum colendo, amando.

page.notes: Faint show-through of text from the reverse page is visible in the background and was omitted. A faint marginal word "Vene" at lower right is a catchword-like fragment; it is not clearly legible and is left out. The "Ducentûm" line is printed as is; "Ducentûm" likely stands for an honorific and may be a misprint for "Dignissimo" context. Dedication headings are in italic and the names in small capitals, rendered here in bold.
